Synopsis:
Postmaster Danzo Arkwright asks the player to find missing letters and will offer a reward on delivery. Reading the letters first will allow the player to blackmail the postmaster.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_Posthouse_Postmaster.json: Danzo Arkwright is the anxious postmaster of Sword Coast Couriers who hired the PC to recover a batch of missing letters and promised a reward for their return — he publicly puts on a chipper, sales‑like front, but off‑screen is worried: pigeon couriers are being picked off and city unrest (a rampaging force nearby) has curtailed deliveries. The player in these samples already has the letters and — whether by choice or curiosity — opened them, giving them leverage: reading the contents creates a clear blackmail opportunity. Danzo’s demeanor shifts from genial to desperate when confronted, and he’s willing to hand over gold to keep whatever the letters contain from becoming public. The wider city turmoil and the damage to courier routes explain his fear of scandal and his readiness to pay to avoid trouble.
- WYR_Posthouse_Pigeon.json: Players can use Speak with Animals to talk to the pigeon at the Post house to find out more information regarding the missing letters. The pigeon will point the player towards the Open Hand Temple roof.
- WYR_SharessCaress_Taproom_Mamzell.json: Mamzell Amira is the proprietress of a bawdy taproom who’s alarmed because one of her escorts — the regular called Ffion the “Stern Librarian” — is gone (in some playthroughs the player reports finding her murdered). The player is visiting to report Ffion’s disappearance and can either accept Amira’s task to look into it or refuse; Amira lacks coin but offers sexual favors as an alternate reward and will point you to the drow twins behind the curtain. Off‑screen context: the Orlith twins (Sorn and Nym) are dapper, professional drow escorts who can be hired or recruited and appear in both public and intimate scenes, and companions (or Halsin) may be nearby. Other nearby world states — the player’s recent tinkering with a windmill that drew goblins, or carrying the Moonlantern/pixie — can explain interruptions or affect choices even though they aren’t shown here.
- LOW_BaldursMouth_PaperBoy_DefaultDialog.json: Dialog with a paper seller outside of the Baldurs Mouth Gazette offices.
- WYR_WyrmRock_FFOfficeGuard_002.json: Dialog with one of the guards in the Flaming Fist Office.

context: Danzo Arkwright is the anxious postmaster of Sword Coast Couriers who hired the player to recover a batch of missing letters and promised a reward for their return. Off‑screen, courier routes have been curtailed by a rampaging force and something is attacking the pigeons used to deliver mail, which has him quietly terrified of scandal.
